complete_examples.text: In the Hertzian contact method, the contact patch is elliptical, which indicates that the relative curvature would be constant in the two main directions.
If the potential contact area is divided into small stripes in the longitudinal, the variation of the wheel-rail lateral relative curvature can be neglected inside each stripe.
